name: def + lambda simple
code:
def f(n):
    return n * 2
h = lambda x: x
print(h(3))

name: def + lambda call
code:
def f(n):
    return n * 2
h = lambda x: f(x)
print(h(3))

name: lambda call def only
code:
def f(n):
    return n * 2
g = lambda: f(4)
print(g())

name: lambda two params
code:
add = lambda a, b: a + b
print(add(3, 4))
